METALWORK — MOCK EXAM #10
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: METALWORK
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. International Cricket Team
   B. Input Cable Tester
   C. Internal Cooking Timer
   D. Information and Communication Technology

2. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

3. When learning Introduction to Metalwork, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Metalwork.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Metalwork.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Metalwork.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Metalwork.

4. When learning Hand tools and bench tools, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Hand tools and bench tools.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Hand tools and bench tools.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Hand tools and bench tools.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Hand tools and bench tools.

5. When learning Measuring and marking out tools 2.3 Ferrous and non-ferrous metals 2.4 Project 3, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   D. Skip safety briefings for Safety in the workshop.

   A. Monitor
   B. Keyboard
   C. CPU
   D. Speaker
